text:
alex: Quick sync — we need owners and state for the SKU <> plan mapping, metering adapter, and contract quota checks before we sign off on the packaging change. Can owners drop status + blockers?
sara: I own the SKU mapping. On track — mapping spec is in the doc: https://redwood.internal/sku-mapping v1.1. Need clarity from billing on promo/legacy SKUs.
dan: Metering adapter (ingest path) is mostly done. PR open: https://git/repo/pulls/412. Waiting on schema final from @sara for upstream tests.
maria: Contract/quotas review: found two customers with hard quota clauses that could block; raising with legal today. cc @alex. If legal says we can't change limits we need a migration plan.
luis: From Billing side — promo SKUs: we have 3 special cases (legacy-free, enterprise-overrides, reseller-bundles). I can add those to the mapping but need expected behavior: bill or bill-neutral?
sara: For legacy-free, goal is bill-neutral for existing active subscriptions. enterprise-overrides should map to enterprise plan, reseller-bundles we should alias to bundle_sku. I'll add those rules to the spec by EOD.
dan: Quick note for integration tests, example payload to expect from mapping service: 
```
{ "sku": "bundle_sku_v2", "plan_id": "pro_plus", "metering_class": "tokens", "quota": 100000 }
```
maria: Legal asked for a list of impacted contracts — @alex can you share the customer list or point me to the query?
alex: Yes — I'll share the BigQuery with access. For now owners: SKU mapping = @sara, Metering adapter = @dan, Billing behaviors = @luis, Contract gating = @maria. Milestones: mapping spec by 2201420000, adapter PR merged by 2201450000, legal signoff by 2201500000.
sara: Adding a couple of follow-ups in the doc for edge rules. Also tagging @billing-bot to run the sample billing scenario next run. :robot_face:
billing-bot: scheduled: sample-billing-run for sku-mapping-test set at 2201360000 — results will be posted in #product.
dan: Blocker: integration test harness failing on kv-cache serialization for large quota values. Investigating, ETA 1 day.
luis: I can do manual checks for promo SKUs in staging tomorrow if we need a quick unblock.
maria: For the contracts: if legal requires consent flow we'll need a migration ETA. Estimate dev work ~3 days — please flag if that becomes a hard blocker.
alex: Thanks everyone. Action items: sara update spec (EOD), dan fix kv-cache test (1d), luis run manual promo tests (tomorrow), maria/legal confirm contract list + consent requirement (by milestone). I'll follow up with a snapshot in 24h. :thumbsup:
